name: psychology
description: AI getting stronger while your own advantage feels unclear? Connect Psychology in a supported chat, bring memories and past chats you choose, and distil grounded strengths and likely answers for your goal before answering only the gaps that matter. Check callable psychology_* MCP tools before any tool-dependent task.

interface.shortDescription: Find your strengths in the AI chats and memories you choose.
interface.longDescription: Bring the memories and past chats available to your connected assistant, or a purpose-limited memory summary or selected conversations from another AI. Psychology helps distil strengths and likely answers for your goal, then asks only for the gaps that still matter. It also offers structured self-assessments and practical reflection.
defaultPrompt: Check whether the Psychology MCP is connected. If not, guide me through secure Codex setup first.

Use relevant memories and past chats this assistant can actually access, plus a purpose-limited memory summary or selected conversations I choose to share from another AI, to distil strengths and likely answers for my goal. Never ask me to upload a full account archive. Before drafting, call psychology_get_profile_distillation_guide once; if the tool is unavailable or the call fails, say so plainly and continue with accessible context. For time-sensitive goals and preferences, distinguish source event or statement time, memory save/update time, summary-generation time, when the claim applied, and when Noesis received a reviewed selection; a recent summary does not make an old goal current. Apply explicit current-session corrections before deciding whether an old claim remains unresolved; a direct correction resolves it for this conversation, so do not repeat the question or recommend a direction based on the superseded claim. The correction does not establish when the prior claim stopped applying; leave an unstated historical boundary unknown and do not backdate it. Ask whether an old goal still applies only if its current status remains unresolved after applying current-session evidence and the answer could change the next step. For this draft, do not call other Noesis tools or claim permission/data checks. Show examples, ask only consequential gaps, and do not imply access to another account's archive.
Before using saved context, show me the available sources and let me choose.
